headline: Set October 19, 2026 at 4:00 p.m. for the Poly Resin Heart Ribbon Cutting Ceremony, with an October 26 rain date; also voted to amend August minutes.
summary: The commission discussed traffic box updates, heart sculpture plaque wording, a landing page and cultural district map, and a children's holiday parade. It set the date for the Poly Resin Heart Ribbon Cutting Ceremony. It also voted to amend the August 8, 2026 minutes.
decisions: Approved holding the Poly Resin Heart Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on October 19, 2026, at 4:00 p.m., with an October 26, 2026 rain date at 3:00 p.m., all in favor.
Approved a motion to amend the August 8, 2026 Arts and Culture Commission regular meeting minutes, all in favor.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to hold the Poly Resin Heart Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on October 19, 2026, at 4:00 p.m., with a rain date of October 26, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. Seconded by Commissioner Salice; all in favor; motion carried.
MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to Amend the August 8, 2026, City Arts and Culture Commission Regular Meeting Minutes. Seconded by Commissioner Crist; all in favor; motion.

decision_titles: Poly Resin Heart Ribbon Cutting Ceremony date
plain_text:
City of Bristol 
Arts & Culture Commission 
 
INFORMATION TO ACCESS MEETING 
https://bristolct-gov.zoom.us/j/83837598503?pwd=7mmPQw4bSobMWVv0x40Niq9zNhCcqm.1 
 
of the Arts & Culture Commission 
October 7, 2026 - 6:00 PM 
 
Ladies and Gentlemen: 
 
The regular meeting was held on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, at 6:00 PM in Meeting Room 1-3 in City 
Hall, 111 North Main Street, Bristol, CT 06010. 
 
1. Call to Order 
Chair Lewandoski called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. 
 a. Pledge of Allegiance 
 
 b. Attendance 
 Members Present:  
Chair Walter Lewandowski 
Vice Chair Andrea Adams 
Commissioner Julie Crist  
Commissioner Juliet Norton 
Commissioner Maria Salice 
Commissioner E. Brad Yancy 
City Council Liaison Greg Hahn 
Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna 
Theriault 
  
Absent: Commissioner Nigel Wynter 
 
  
 
2. Approval of Minutes 
 
 a. Approval of Minutes: September 2, 2026, City Arts and Culture Commission 
Regular Meeting Minutes
3. Public Participation 
None. 
4. Arts and Culture Supervisor's Report 
 
 a. Supervisor's Report 
 Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna Therriault presented the Supervisor's Report. 
Discussion followed.  
 
 b. Project Spreadsheet 
 Nothing to report.  
 
 c. Year-to-Date Financials 
 Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna Therriault presented the Year-to-Date Financials. No 
discussion needed.  
 
5. Chairman's Report 
Chair Walter Lewandoski presented the Chairman's Report. Chair Lewandoski discussed his 
recent visit to Summerville, MA, and told the commission he wanted to speak with its Arts and 
Culture Commission to learn how they operate. Discussion followed.  
Chair Lewandoski attended the last Veterans Council meeting about the mural, and the 
Veterans Council was receptive to the concept and wanted to see a full-color draft. Discussion 
followed. 
6. Old Business 
 
 a. Traffic Box Updates: Cassandra Sims at Stafford Ave and Washington St., and 
Joe Johnson and Chair Lewandoski at Green Hills and Pine Street.  
 Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna Therriault presented the Traffic Box Updates. 
Discussion followed. 
 
 b. Decide on a Date for the Poly Resin Heart Ribbon Cutting Ceremony 
 Arts and Culture Supervisor Arianna Therriault presented dates for the Poly Resin Heart 
Ribbon Cutting Ceremony. Discussion followed.  
 
MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to hold the Poly Resin Heart Ribbon Cutting 
Ceremony on October 19, 2026, at 4:00 p.m., with a rain date of October 26, 2026, at 3:00 
p.m. 
Seconded by Commissioner Salice; all in favor; motion carried.
c. Confirm Plaque Verbiage for Heart Sculptures 
 The Arts and Culture Supervisor, Arianna Therriault, presented the confirmed verbiage for the 
Heart Sculptures. Discussion followed.  
 
 d. Arts and Culture Commission Landing Page/Cultural District Map 
 The Arts and Culture Supervisor, Arianna Therriault, presented the Arts and Culture 
Commission Landing Page/Cultural District Map and asked the commission for input. 
Discussion followed. 
 
 e. Motion to Amend the August 8, 2026, City Arts and Culture Commission 
Regular Meeting Minutes 
 MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to Amend the August 8, 2026, City Arts and Culture 
Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.  
Seconded by Commissioner Crist; all in favor; motion.  
 
 f. By Commissioners 
 None. 
 
7. New Business 
 
 a. Bristol Children's Holiday Parade in Reverse 
 The Arts and Culture Supervisor, Arianna Therriault, informed the commission about the 
Bristol Children's Holiday Parade in Reverse. 
 
 b. By Commissioners 
 Chair Lewandoski presented a Grant Application submitted on behalf of Bristol Arts and 
Innovation Magnet School's Music Department to assist with a fundraising event for their 
trip to Europe. Discussion followed.  
 
8. Reports and Committee Reports 
 
 a. City Council Liaison Report 
 City Council Liaison Greg Hahn presented the City Council Liaison Report. Discussion 
followed.  
 
9. Adjournment 
MOTION: Made by Vice Chair Adams to adjourn at 7:07 p.m. 
Seconded by Commissioner Salice; all in favor; motion carried.
Respectfully Submitted,  
Amaris Estrada 
Recording Secretary 
City Arts and Culture Commission
